title.narrative: Connecting Economic Clusters for Inclusive Growth in Maharashtra

description.narrative: The project will support the further development of the state's strategic core road network by (i) connecting underdeveloped rural communities, in particular women and other disadvantaged groups, with city centers and nearby industrial zones; (ii) providing direct and indirect opportunities to the primarily agrarian population, in particular woman and other disadvantaged groups, through improved access to markets, health and social services; (iii) improving road connectivity of border districts such as Nanded to neighboring states; (iv) improving industrial value chains for small scale industry by reducing transportation costs; and (v) improving disaster risk and climate change resilience in flood-prone areas.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: New interstate roads connecting Nanded and Telangana developed and maintained Indicator: 10-year performance-based maintenance contracts commenced for 5 km of new major districts roads Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 10-year performance-based maintenance not yet started. Maintenance Manual preparation is being prepared. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD

Output: New interstate roads connecting Nanded and Telangana developed and maintained Indicator: At least 5km of major district roads constructed with climate-and disaster-resilient features Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: The bypass road, located in district Nanded having total length 5.0 km is under final stage of construction. As on 31st December 2025, out of 5.0 km length 4.875 Km road length is completed and balance length of 0.125 likely to be completed in by end of January 2026. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD

Output: State highways and major district roads of the core road network upgraded and maintained Indicator: 10-year performance-based maintenance contracts commenced for 468 km of roads Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Commencement of 10 -year performance-based maintenance contract is initiated for completed 14 nos. of projects. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD

Output: State highways and major district roads of the core road network upgraded and maintained Indicator: At least 319 km state highways and 149 km of major district roads upgraded with climate-and disaster-resilient features as well as EWCD-responsive features Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: As of 31st December in 2025, out of 319 Km of state highway (SH) ,292.845 km road length is completed. Similarly, out of 149 km of MDRs, 149 km road length is completed. Accordingly, the total completed road length is 441.845 Km out of total 468.66 Km.
Furthermore, EWCD works such as EWCD enabled bus shelters at 36 locations are completed and in progress at 28 locations. Similarly, construction of toilet blocks at 9 locations are completed and in progress at 24 locations. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD

Output: Capacity for project monitoring, road safety and maintenance strengthened Indicator: At least 54 habitations in the project area reached by road safety awareness campaigns of women-led self-help groups Progress/Status: QIIS-GESI is in place since October 2025 and engaged to complete other indicators. The Module for Training of the trainer is finalized. The SHGs are listed and consultation as well as selection of interested women is in progress. The ToT is likely to be commenced in 2nd /3rd week of February 2026. After that road safety campaigns through trained SHGs women will be initiated from 1st / 2nd week of March 2026. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Capacity for project monitoring, road safety and maintenance strengthened Indicator: At least two contract modalities for road maintenance involving private sector developed for other roads forming the CRN using output- and performance-based maintenance contracts or area-based contracts Progress/Status: Long-Term Output & Performance-Based Road Assets Maintenance Contract, The OPRMC model is being executed on a pilot basis in the Thane district. Data Source: Report with recommendation on contract modality endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Capacity for project monitoring, road safety and maintenance strengthened Indicator: Automated traffic survey and traffic direction systems implemented at 10 locations on project roads Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Automated Traffic Survey are identified and the same has been conveyed to ADB vide mail dated 12th Nov 2025. The activity will be performed twice a year for next 2 years. The process of appointing Agency to conduct automated traffic survey and traffic direction systems is in progress. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Y Actual value: 0

Output: Capacity for project monitoring, road safety and maintenance strengthened Indicator: Good practice handbook for climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction in road design and maintenance developed and implemented in 5 roads Progress/Status: The draft report has already been submitted to ADB for their review and remarks. Once the inputs are received, the Handbook will be finalized. Data Source: Final handbook on climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction in road design and maintenance Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Capacity for project monitoring, road safety and maintenance strengthened Indicator: Two road safety demonstration corridors with advanced technology, improved standards for design, construction and enforcement established on project roads Progress/Status: Roads as Safety Demonstration Corridor has been identified one in Nanded District and another one is in Sangli district. In this regard, a joint site visit has been conducted with the IRAP consultant. The report from the iRAP consultant is received, and recommendations are being implemented. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Capacity for project monitoring, road safety and maintenance strengthened Indicator: Web interface and dashboard with real-time information to monitor traffic, design, contracting and construction progress, land acquisition and compensation disbursement established and managed by MPWD Progress/Status: The facility “Project Performance Monitoring System” (PPMS) which is a web interface dashboard to monitor project performance is functioning on MPWD server. The same is being updated regularly. Data Source: Progress reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Gender equality and social inclusion promoted in highway works, schools, health and social services Indicator: At least 15 people from women-led self-help groups of which 90% are female, report increased knowledge and skills on operating the Janasuvidha Kendras Progress/Status: The identification of tentative locations for Jansuvidha Kendras is currently underway. Once the construction is complete, training programs will be conducted for self-help groups, led by women, to equip them with the necessary skills to manage and operate these centers effectively. Data Source: Survey results and GESI monitoring reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: Gender equality and social inclusion promoted in highway works, schools, health and social services Indicator: At least 18 water and sanitation facilities provided at schools along project roads Progress/Status: Construction of toilet blocks is ongoing across all EPC projects. As of now, 48 out of 96 toilet blocks have been completed, and an additional 16 toilet blocks are currently under construction. Data Source: Survey results and GESI monitoring reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: Gender equality and social inclusion promoted in highway works, schools, health and social services Indicator: At least 3 demonstration Janasuvidha Kendras developed in three project districts for women cane cutters and migrant population to provide basic health and sanitation, education, and other services Progress/Status: The tentative location for establishing the Jana Suvidha Kendra has been identified in EPC-13, 14 & 23, and the typical drawing has been prepared and finalized. The identification of site and design for two locations is prepared and procurement will be taken up in hand after approval of ADB for Bid document. Data Source: Survey results and GESI monitoring reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: Gender equality and social inclusion promoted in highway works, schools, health and social services Indicator: At least 36 people from 18 women led enterprises from poor and disadvantaged groups, of which 80% are female, provided certified skills training for livelihood opportunities as wayside service providers Progress/Status: GESI key activities to be completed on Q4 2026. The responsibility of executing this activity is under the scope of QII(GESI). Data Source: Survey results and GESI monitoring reports endorsed by MPWD Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2022 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: Gender equality and social inclusion promoted in highway works, schools, health and social services Indicator: Guidelines for GESI-responsive state highway works programs prepared and implemented at 8 locations Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: GESI key activities to be completed on Q4 2026.
